claims.claim: Banco de México describes the Libertad silver series design, its origin, and historical addition of fractional sizes.
The new series page lists silver Libertad sizes, fineness, diameters, and finishes, including later two and five ounce sizes.
Banco de México’s 2000 bulletin documents a redesign of the one ounce Libertad and design differences among sizes.
The Spanish Banco de México page provides the official silver series specifications and design history.
